integrity: Analytical proof of the matrix formula, strict uniqueness, and endpoint limits; independent quadrature and numerical checks are supplementary, not an infinite-dimensional proof.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted upper half-plane; a two-dimensional biharmonic Fourier fiber; D-optimal determinant only; no global Fredholm determinant or trace; original priority provisional because not all relevant full texts accessible.
title: D-optimal slab concentration for biharmonic Bergman modes: a quartic-to-logarithmic crossover
